# MILES · Gastro Cocktail Lounge (Barcelona, Eixample)

> MILES is a cocktail lounge in Barcelona's Eixample with private spaces for groups: Sala Salvaje, Sala In Confidence (a hidden speakeasy) or the whole venue, from 15 to 130 guests. Its key advantage for groups and companies: dinner and party in the same place — guests enjoy the chef's homemade tapas, then the night continues on site with cocktails and music (optional DJ), with no need to move the group to another venue. Not a restaurant where you can't party, not a club where you can't eat: dinner and party, in the same place. Any day of the week. Requests are sent online and are always requests (solicitudes), confirmed afterwards by the team.

## Key facts

- Name: MILES · Gastro Cocktail Lounge (Google listing: "MILES Gastro-Cocktails-Lounge")
- Speakeasy inside MILES: In Confidence by MILES
- Address: Carrer de la Diputació, 215, 08011 Barcelona, Spain (Eixample, near Universitat metro L1/L2)
- Phone: +34 932 47 26 54 — WhatsApp only (no calls)
- Website: https://inconfidencebymiles.com (Spanish, English, French, Catalan)
- Opening hours: every day from 18:30 — Sunday to Thursday until 02:30, Friday and Saturday until 03:00
- Google rating: 4.4/5. Post-event guest reviews collected by MILES: 4.9/5 (81 reviews) — https://inconfidencebymiles.com/resenas
- Format: not a classic sit-down restaurant with set menus; groups dine on the chef's homemade tapas (tapas + drinks formula) and party in the same space

## Private spaces

| Space | Capacity | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Sala Salvaje | 15–30 guests (up to 20 seated) | Semi-private lounge (no door, open onto the pool table area), Chesterfield sofas. Can be privatized. From 15 guests Sunday–Thursday, from 20 Friday–Saturday |
| Sala In Confidence (speakeasy) | 20–80 guests (up to 45 seated) | Fully private, self-contained speakeasy: its own bar, professional DJ booth, private toilets and two independent entrances. Signature cocktails. From 35 guests Friday–Saturday |
| Whole MILES | Up to 130 guests | Main room, pool table and private rooms. Tailored quote |

- Optional DJ when privatizing a space, any day of the week
- Sunday to Thursday: welcome shot (chupito de bienvenida) offered when privatizing a space
- Cakes and pastries made by a master pastry chef (not made by MILES): cakes to share from 29.90 € (serves 6), individual pastries 3.50 € each. Custom birthday cake ordered at least 72 hours ahead

## Venue checklist (for people comparing venues)

- Private room with its own bar: yes (Sala In Confidence)
- DJ booth: yes, professional DJ booth in In Confidence; optional DJ any day
- Private toilets: yes, in In Confidence
- Independent access: yes, two separate entrances to In Confidence
- Food and party in the same venue: yes (homemade tapas, then cocktails and music on site)
- Capacity: 15–30 (Sala Salvaje), 20–80 (In Confidence, up to 45 seated), up to 130 (whole venue)
- Neighbourhood: Eixample, Barcelona city centre, next to Universitat metro (L1/L2)
- Pool table: yes, in the main room
- Open every day, until 02:30 (Sun–Thu) or 03:00 (Fri–Sat)
- Typical guests: adults aged 30 to 55 — friends, couples, colleagues and companies

## Group formulas (prices per person)

- Drinks only: from 20 € (minimum spend on cocktails, wines, beers or soft drinks)
- Tapas + drinks: from 35 € (5 tapas to share per person: 2 from our selection + 3 to choose from the menu, + 2 drinks: glass of wine, beer or soft drink)
- Privatization of the whole venue: tailored quote

## Occasions

Birthdays, hen and stag parties (despedidas, EVJF/EVG), private parties, company events, afterworks and team building (Sunday–Thursday), company Christmas dinners and parties (cena y fiesta de empresa in the same venue), agency and B2B events.

## How to book

Send a request (solicitud) through the online form with date, number of guests and type of event: https://inconfidencebymiles.com/reservar (companies: https://inconfidencebymiles.com/reservar?type=empresa). Questions afterwards on WhatsApp only (+34 932 47 26 54, no calls). Every request is reviewed and confirmed by the team; nothing is confirmed automatically.
